exclusions: This manifest excludes itself to avoid a self-referential checksum.
Disposable build trees, virtualenvs, caches and fixture namespace internals are not unique evidence; exact candidate commits, harnesses, own wheels, logs and freeze are retained.
trust_limits: Checksums detect divergence, not authenticated origin, approval or immutable retention. Git commit storage is the authorized task retention channel; no external package publication.
temporary_cleanup: Only /tmp/institutional-resume task-owned disposable work is removed after verified retention and final checks; unrelated /tmp files are not touched.
